title: Concept: Worker script from plaintext HTTP
description: A worker constructed from a plaintext URL in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A worker runs off the main thread with the page's origin, so a substituted worker script keeps access even after the page is closed.
applicability: Deployments that render a worker constructed from a plaintext URL into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A worker runs off the main thread with the page's origin, so a substituted worker script keeps access even after the page is closed.
